title: Privacy Policy
intro: This Privacy Policy describes how ItalBridge Partners collects, uses, and protects your personal data in compliance with the Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019 and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: ItalBridge Partners (“ItalBridge”, “we”, “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect personal data when you interact with our website and services. We comply with the Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019, and align our practices with the principles of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) (Regulation 2016/679).

sections.title: Data We Collect
sections.text: We collect personal data you provide voluntarily, including: your name, email address, phone number, company name, country/region, and any information you include in inquiry messages. We may also collect technical data automatically, such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited, through cookies and similar technologies (see our Cookie Policy).

sections.title: Legal Basis for Processing
sections.text: Under the GDPR, we process personal data on the following legal bases: (a) your consent, when you submit an inquiry or subscribe to communications; (b) our legitimate interests in responding to business inquiries and operating our services; and (c) compliance with legal obligations. Under the Kenya Data Protection Act, processing is based on your consent and our legitimate business purpose.

sections.title: How We Use Your Data
sections.text: We use your personal data to: respond to your inquiries; assess commercial fit between manufacturers and buyers; provide procurement coordination and after-sales support; send relevant communications where you have consented; maintain records for legal and accounting purposes; and improve our website and services.

sections.title: Data Sharing
sections.text: We do not sell personal data. We may share your data with: Italian manufacturing partners where you have initiated a commercial inquiry; logistics and customs service providers involved in a transaction; and professional advisors where legally required. All sharing is limited to what is necessary for the stated purpose.

sections.title: International Transfers
sections.text: As ItalBridge operates across Kenya and Italy, your personal data may be transferred between these jurisdictions. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for any cross-border transfer, in compliance with the Kenya Data Protection Act and the GDPR.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.text: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, including legal, accounting, or reporting requirements. Inquiries are retained for the duration of a commercial relationship and a reasonable period thereafter. You may request deletion of your data at any time (see Data Request).

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.text: Under the GDPR and the Kenya Data Protection Act, you have the right to: access your personal data; rectify inaccurate data; erase your data (“right to be forgotten”); restrict or object to processing; data portability; and withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, submit a request through our Data Access & Deletion Request page.

sections.title: Security
sections.text: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be notified on our website. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text: For privacy enquiries, contact us at info@italbridgepartners.co.ke or via our Data Request page.
